task.title: Contact Field Mapping Configuration Interface
task.description: Build a comprehensive field mapping configuration UI that allows admins to customize which fields sync between Salesforce and Renzo contacts. The interface should include: (1) A mapping table view showing source field → destination field pairs with data type indicators, (2) Add/Edit mapping modal with dropdowns populated from Salesforce field metadata API and Renzo contact schema, field type validation ensuring compatible types (text→text, date→date, etc.), and transformation options (trim whitespace, format phone numbers, default values), (3) Drag-to-reorder functionality for mapping priority, (4) Toggle switches to enable/disable individual mappings without deletion, (5) Sync direction selector per mapping (Salesforce→Renzo, Renzo→Salesforce, or bidirectional), (6) Conflict resolution rules dropdown (Salesforce wins, Renzo wins, most recent wins, manual review), (7) Real-time validation showing errors for incompatible field types or missing required mappings, (8) Preview section showing sample data transformation before saving, (9) Reset to defaults button, (10) Save configuration with confirmation modal showing which contacts will be affected, (11) Export/Import mapping configuration as JSON for backup or migration between environments. Use existing `.modal`, `.form-group`, `.btn` class systems. Persist mappings in new `field_mappings` database table with columns: id, salesforce_field, renzo_field, direction, enabled, transformation_rules, conflict_resolution, sort_order, created_at, updated_at.
task.rationale: With the activity dashboard now providing visibility into sync operations, the most critical missing piece is the ability to control WHAT data syncs. Currently, field mappings are likely hardcoded, making the system inflexible for different business needs. This feature unblocks customization for various Salesforce configurations, enables users to add custom fields without code changes, reduces sync errors from incompatible field types, and is a prerequisite for advanced features like conditional sync rules or field-level permissions. This is foundational infrastructure that should be built before adding more monitoring features or expanding sync capabilities to other objects.

issues: Critical Security Vulnerabilities: No CSRF protection on state-changing operations, inline event handlers bypass CSP, unvalidated sessionStorage data creates cache poisoning risk, and missing authentication state management

Severe Accessibility Failures: Emoji used instead of proper icons/labels, drag-and-drop lacks keyboard support, toggle switches missing ARIA attributes, buttons lack aria-labels - making interface unusable for screen reader users

Production-Breaking Implementation Flaws: Truncated UI text ('Searc'), unencoded SVG data URIs causing browser parsing issues, no responsive design for mobile (<768px), no error boundaries or validation
data.feedback: MUST FIX BEFORE DEPLOYMENT: 1) Add CSRF tokens to all form submissions and API calls (use meta tag + header), 2) Replace all inline onclick handlers with addEventListener and proper CSP, 3) Validate/sanitize sessionStorage data on retrieval, 4) Replace emoji (🔍, ⚙️, etc.) with proper SVG icons + aria-labels, 5) Add role='switch', aria-checked, aria-label to all toggles, 6) URL-encode SVG data URI special characters (# → %23), 7) Implement keyboard handlers for drag-and-drop (Space/Enter to grab, arrows to move), 8) Fix truncated 'Searc' placeholder, 9) Add media queries for <768px screens, 10) Implement client-side validation with HTML5 patterns and error messages, 11) Add error boundary UI components, 12) Add session timeout handling. Code length (24940 chars) indicates over-engineering - consider component modularization. Current state is not production-ready due to security and accessibility violations.

issues: Critical security vulnerabilities: CSRF token placeholder, missing CSP headers, and no input sanitization allows XSS attacks through user-controlled field mappings

Severe accessibility violations: no ARIA labels/roles, custom toggle divs instead of semantic inputs, missing focus management, and no keyboard navigation for drag-drop functionality fails WCAG 2.1 AA
Incomplete implementation with undefined dependencies (debounce function), truncated sanitizeArray function, and missing validation logic creates runtime errors in production
data.feedback: REQUIRED FIXES: 1) Implement server-side CSRF token generation and validation, add Content-Security-Policy meta tag with strict directives. 2) Replace all custom div controls with semantic HTML (use <input type='checkbox' role='switch'> for toggles), add comprehensive ARIA labels/roles/live regions, implement keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape) with visible focus indicators. 3) Complete sanitizeArray function, define debounce utility, add DOMPurify for input sanitization, implement input validation with error messages. 4) Add responsive breakpoints for mobile (<768px collapse sidebar), loading/disabled states on buttons, and rate limiting (max 1 request/500ms). 5) Add autocomplete attributes, verify WCAG AA color contrast (minimum 4.5:1), implement proper focus trap in modals. PRIORITY: Fix security issues first (CSRF, CSP, XSS), then accessibility (ARIA, keyboard nav, semantic HTML), then complete missing implementations.

issues: CSP 'unsafe-inline' allows inline scripts and styles, reducing XSS protection - Remove 'unsafe-inline' from CSP directives and implement nonce-based CSP. Add nonce attributes to all inline scripts/styles and generate unique nonces server-side per request.

CSRF token placeholder is hardcoded instead of being dynamically injected - Replace the hardcoded 'your-csrf-token-here' with server-side template injection (e.g., {{ csrf_token }}) or fetch from a secure meta tag/cookie on page load.

Incomplete code: showToast function is cut off mid-implementation, missing removal logic - Complete the toast notification implementation with proper timeout-based removal logic and ensure the function handles edge cases like rapid successive calls.
data.feedback: Critical security vulnerabilities must be addressed before deployment. 1) Implement proper CSP with nonces instead of 'unsafe-inline' - generate server-side nonces and add them to script/style tags. 2) Replace CSRF token placeholder with dynamic server-side injection using your framework's CSRF protection mechanism. 3) Complete the showToast function with proper cleanup logic. Additional fixes needed: Add SRI hashes to Google Fonts link tag, implement server-side permission validation (client-side checks are bypassable), add ARIA labels to all interactive elements (toggles, modals, tables), implement focus trapping for modals, add responsive breakpoints for mobile screens, implement proper error boundaries, and ensure all user-generated content is sanitized before rendering. The authentication flow needs HTTPS enforcement checks in production environments.

issues: Critical Security: CSP nonce and SRI hash placeholders ({{CSP_NONCE}}, {{SRI_HASH}}) are not implemented - requires server-side template rendering. CSRF token also uses placeholder requiring backend integration. Without proper implementation, security headers are ineffective.

Critical Accessibility Violations: Missing ARIA labels on navigation, buttons, form controls, and modal. No focus trap in modal, no keyboard escape handler, icon buttons lack accessible text. Table missing semantic ARIA. Fails WCAG 2.1 AA standards - unusable for screen reader users.

High Security Risk: sessionStorage stores sensitive field schema data vulnerable to XSS. Missing input sanitization on search-input. Incomplete sanitizeHTML function (code truncated). No rate limiting on API endpoints. These create multiple attack vectors for malicious actors.
data.feedback: REQUIRED FIXES: 1) Implement server-side template rendering (e.g., EJS, Handlebars) to replace {{CSP_NONCE}}, {{SRI_HASH}}, and {{CSRF_TOKEN}} placeholders with actual values. Remove SRI for Google Fonts or generate valid hash. 2) Add comprehensive ARIA attributes: aria-label on navigation/buttons, role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' on modal, implement focus trap, add keyboard escape (Escape key), aria-label on icon buttons, role='table/row/cell' on data table, aria-describedby for form errors. 3) Complete sanitizeHTML function using DOMPurify library. Sanitize search input before any reflection. Move field schemas from sessionStorage to memory-only variables. Add rate limiting middleware (express-rate-limit). 4) Add :focus-visible polyfill for older browsers, ensure min 3:1 contrast ratios, implement mobile responsive breakpoints (<768px) with collapsible sidebar. 5) Systematize z-index scale (1-10, 100-110, etc.). Add critical error handling for missing CSRF tokens beyond console.log. These are blocking issues - do not deploy without fixes.

missing: PreviewSection with side-by-side sample data comparison
ExportImportModal with tabbed interface for JSON export/import
Sample records display (3-5 examples) with transformation highlighting
data.note: Only basic HTML structure with CSS styling is present. Missing all core modal components (AddEditMappingModal, ConfirmationModal, ExportImportModal), interactive functionality (drag-to-reorder, real-time preview, validation), transformation rules UI, conflict resolution configuration, and data persistence. The code appears to be incomplete foundation without the primary specification requirements implemented.

blocking_issues: Missing closing style tag - CSS is truncated mid-declaration, breaking the entire stylesheet
CSP nonce placeholders ({{CSP_NONCE}}) not being replaced server-side will break inline styles and scripts
Font integrity hash {{SRI_HASH}} placeholder will cause font loading failure
No skip-to-content link for keyboard users to bypass sidebar navigation
Toggle switches lack accessible labels/ARIA attributes - screen readers cannot determine state or purpose
Modal lacks focus trapping - keyboard users can tab to background content when modal is open
Modal close button has no accessible label (aria-label) - screen readers announce as 'button' only
Drag-and-drop functionality has no keyboard alternative for reordering table rows
Missing closing <th> tag (line with 'Renzo Field'): `<th<scope="col">` should be `<th scope="col">`
Inline event handlers (onclick, onchange) violate CSP nonce policy - all JS should use addEventListener
No keyboard navigation for drag-drop reordering - accessibility violation for keyboard-only users
Alert/console.log for errors/success is not screen reader accessible - need ARIA live regions
Modal manipulation references 'addEditModal' element that doesn't exist in provided HTML
Drag handle '⋮⋮' has aria-label but is not keyboard accessible (not a button/focusable element)
No error boundaries for async failures - network errors leave UI in broken state
sessionStorage caching without error handling could crash on storage quota exceeded
